newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 8.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:
* The governing party that controlled Mexican politics for seven decades lost command of the national Congress in elections.
* The New York City school chancellor reversed himself to say he would accept the school board's choice for district superintendent.
* Color photos from Mars show the planet was once swept by surging waters.
* A Saudi suspect recently deported to the U.S. said that he was in Iran when a bombing in Saudi Arabia killed 19 American servicemen in 1996.
* Rigged lotteries have become the biggest fraud in Russia.
